verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vapi's own MCP Server, which exposes Vapi APIs to external MCP clients like Claude Desktop. That is the server role, not a voice agent consuming MCP servers as tool sources. The only tool-extension evidence covers webhook-based custom tools and Make/GHL imports, which are a different mechanism. Nothing documents an MCP-client tool type that would let an assistant load whole toolsets mid-call.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
